entry_state: Acceptance separates engineering, accounting and scientific validity. Forecast protocols preserve exact information availability, whole-package extraction and finite reconstruction targets. Conditional financial prediction now begins with a fixed reported target and equal-information comparators.
exit_state: The evaluation protocols preserve distinct targets after company composition. Dependency-ordered implementation remains a future design sequence, and convenience choices remain replaceable. The concrete corpus protocol now distinguishes source acquisition from semantic and historical-information closure.
findings: CRPS is defined for an admitted finite-first-moment law, illustrated without treating one outcome as ranking evidence.
E4–E6 retain reserve conditioning, sampler target checks and reviewed task correctness as different criteria.
Exposed development rungs cannot promote methods; under-budgeted learned components do not inherit an architecture.
Joined group arithmetic cannot validate its predictive or valuation inputs. The P0–P6 table specifies dependencies rather than an authorised running implementation.
